name: Seeed reTerminal E1002
description: 7.3 inch 6-colour Spectra 6 ePaper terminal, ESP32-S3, battery-powered (800x480). Pairs with the tesserae-device-firmware ESP-IDF build (unified firmware, boards/seeed_reterminal_e1002.h) and speaks Tesserae's v1 REST device API. Server-side pack via esp32_bin produces a 4-bpp Spectra 6 buffer (192000 bytes) that the firmware paints without any on-device quantise.
notes_md: Confirmed on real hardware running tesserae-device-firmware. Palette nibbles align with the firmware's EPD_COL_* constants byte-for-byte (black=0x0, white=0x1, yellow=0x2, red=0x3, blue=0x5, green=0x6; 0x4 and 0x7 reserved), so the frame paints without any on-device translation. If you have an E1002 flashed with TRMNL BYOS firmware instead of the tesserae unified firmware, the trmnl_png_color renderer + trmnl_client protocol path still works; register the device against the trmnl_client kind directly and pick trmnl_png_color as the renderer.
